{{Quote|And then I had dinner with the Slith and fought a Burning Snake and ate from the greatest cactus you ever saw and&hellip;|Chichak|<ref name="GG2-1" />}}
'''Chichak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gerb]] from [[Yavin 13/Legends|Yavin 13]].

==Biography==
A restless spirit,<ref name="GG2-2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref> Chichak loved to explore the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of [[Yavin 13/Legends|Yavin 13]], wandering from his burrow for [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] at a time.<ref name="GG2-1" /> The elders of the burrow believed that the youth sought enlightenment. In truth, Chichak was looking for cacti that he could either knock down or burn.<ref name="GG2-2" /> Upon his return, he would regale his burrowmates with stories of his adventures, which they loved to hear.<ref name="GG2-1" /> However, the stories were not entirely truthful, and his theories of the way the world worked often made his elders despair due to inaccuracies.<ref name="GG2-2" /> On one such journey, Chichak encountered a scouting team from [[Fernandin Scouting Expedition]],<ref name="GG2-1" /> following it for several weeks. Chichak learned their [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|language]] and told them inaccurate stories of Gerb society. After returning to his burrow with the tale of the strange biped, he was displeased to learn no one believed him. Determined to prove his story, Chichak set off in search of the [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="GG2-2" /> He eventually found them, bringing them back to his burrow.<ref name="GG2-1" />

In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] wiped out all life from Yavin 13, causing the extinction of the Gerb species, meaning that Chichak was killed then, if he hadn't already died at some point prior.<ref name="GATOR" />

==Personality and traits==
Tall for a Gerb, standing 1.1 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, Chichak had long hind legs, tall ears, and sharp claws. His fur was light [[Color/Legends|brown]].<ref name="GG2-1" /> Easily bored, Chichak constantly sought out entertainment. He was below average intelligence for a Gerb, and was gullible and dimwitted, although he had a flair for telling tall tales.<ref name="GG2-2" /> Chichak spoke quickly, and was hyper even for a Gerb; he loved to tell stories, explore, and play jokes.<ref name="GG2-1" />

==Equipment==
Chichak carried around a collection of polished [[rock]]s.<ref name="GG2-1" />
